Republican congressman Blake D. Moore switched his vote, following the tie vote on Impeachment, NOT to "move the vote along," as stated in the original text. Rather, it is only by being on one side or another of the vote that a congressperson can re-introduce the same question in the future. Once they saw they had lost the impeachment battle (a tie), one Republican switched, so that he may re-introduce impeachment of Mayorkas in the future.
